execution_mode: Each unittest case executes in an isolated Python interpreter; executable evaluations use isolated fixture repositories and isolated HOME/CODEX_HOME directories.
limitations: The suite validates deterministic local behavior, synthetic hook payloads, migration safety, release gates, and executable offline evaluations.
Live Codex model quality, real Codex plugin switching and session-hook delivery, native plugin behavior, real subagent ordering, cancellation delivery, and cross-client reconnect require RC evidence.
verification_note: The 116-case verified seed baseline is preserved. Product OS 4.1 adds five receipt v2 compatibility cases, seven rebuildable-registry and crash-safe lock cases, eleven read-only detection/dry-run planning cases, five external backup cases, nineteen provider-neutral adoption transaction and migration-doctor cases, seven Local Git provider cases, thirteen bounded Codex selector adapter cases, six privacy-minimized lifecycle cases, and three trusted CLI cases. Manager coverage includes end-to-end local-to-Git adoption, canonical Git object-database provenance, exact adapter binding and selector diffs, full plugin coverage, two-phase multi-plugin switching, journal integrity, ownership-envelope CAS, compensation, rollback, orphan recovery and transaction discovery, read-only diagnosis without a surviving source repository, active-home refusal, lifecycle pending-to-PASS evidence with bounded retention, subprocess CLI fail-closed behavior, zero-write rejection, and preservation of unrelated selector and registry state. Real Codex plugin mutation remains outside this deterministic report.
